title: Verifier Startup from the Assembly Blank
statement: Let $S,V$ be finite deterministic machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $c$ be a configuration of $S$ on $x$, let $y$ be a Boolean word, and let $b$ be a Boolean choice bit. One host step under $b$ from the assembly-rewind configuration built from $c,y$ with assembly head at cell $-1$ equals the verifier-phase configuration for the initial configuration of $V$ on $y$, with boundary tag true, input head at the position of $c$, and the scheduler tapes and heads inherited from $c$.
replaced: Let $S, V$ be deterministic machines, $d$ a scheduler configuration and $y$ an assembled word. For any choice bit, one host step from the assembly-rewind configuration with head at cell $-1$ yields the verifier-phase configuration for the initial configuration of $V$ on $y$, with interior boundary tag, blank verifier tapes and empty captured output.
